title: PresenceConfigDeclineReason - Data API
description: Represents the settings for a decline reason that a presence user provides when declining work. This object is available in API version 37.0 and later.

PresenceDeclineReasonId.description: The ID of the PresenceDeclineReason record.

PresenceUserConfigId.description: The ID of the PresenceUserConfig record where the decline reasons are added.

special_access_rules:
To access this object, Omni-Channel must be enabled. As of Spring ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.
